title: An agent makes a sizzle reel of a real app end to end, and every gap it hits becomes a task
goal: Use only the agent tools to make a 45 to 60 second high energy reel showing off an app's features: smooth Apple-like motion, music that builds, the best moments of the app, and a crescendo that reveals something big. Write down every place the tools could not do what the reel needed, and turn each into a task. This is the benchmark that steers the rest of the sizzle reel work.
notes:
User, 2026-11-24: "I also want to have the agent make high quality 'sizzle reels'... What prevents us from having enough control to make high videlity sizzle reals that really slap. I'm talking apple smoothness coupled with high energy music that builds as we demonstrate features of aplications. And the features are smooth - we capture the most credible moments of an app, making the user really pumped to use them. With creshendos that build up and reveal something massive. We need video features that can do that. Help refine the flows and ensure that agents have the tools to do this".

What agents can reach today (checked 2026-11-24, plugin/skills/photonz/SKILL.md and the MCP tool list): new_video, add_clip, move_clip, trim, cut, add_title, list_titles, set_transition, apply_zooms, recommended_zooms (from recorded clicks), set_keys / change_keys with named curves, video_frame, contact_sheet, export, list_history. NOT reachable by an agent: music or any sound placement and levels, beats of any kind (nothing in Sources analyses tempo or beats), speed changes (the app has setSpeed and speed stops as commands, no agent tool), recording the screen or driving the app being shown, and any way to judge motion rather than stills. Exists in the app but not checked for agent reach: motion smear (MotionSmearFilter), depth transitions, keyframe curves, title entrances.

This task is re-run as the bar after the other sizzle tasks land: the second reel should close most of the first report's gaps. Reels are agent output, so the no-hardcoded-content principle applies: techniques, tools and request-time material, never a stored reel, a template keyed to one app, or a pass tuned to one eval case. Judge on a held-out set of different apps and briefs.
acceptance: A reference board under queue/audits/: at least 12 real launch and sizzle videos (Apple product and feature films, WWDC openers, Linear, Arc, Raycast, Figma Config, Stripe Sessions and similar), each broken down: length, structure (hook, build, crescendo, reveal, end card) with timestamps, cuts per minute in each section, how cuts and text hit the music, camera moves, type treatment, and the one idea that makes it land. The rules drawn from it go into docs/design as sizzle reel guidance.

A reel made by an agent through the MCP tools alone (no hand edits in the app, no code written for this reel), of Photonz itself and of one other app, each with music. Every step the agent wanted and could not do is logged with what it tried.

A gap report in the audit, ranked by how much each gap costs the reel: missing tools, tools that exist but cannot do enough, quality problems (jitter, stutter, soft text) and where the agent could not tell whether its own reel was any good. Each gap that is not already one of the sizzle reel tasks (beats, capture, review, motion, type, skill) is filed as a p1 task under this epic.

The reels and a side by side with two board references, exported at 1080p60 and 4K, named in the audit for the user to watch, with an honest score from a blind vision-model and listening rubric against the references.
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: First pass done from the intake window on 2026-11-26 through the MCP tools: queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/README.md with the reel and pictures. Gaps found and filed: 3d-transitions-ease-in-and-out-of-the-picture-in, speeding-up-a-clip-in-an-edit-leaves-no-black-ho, music-made-of-several-sound-clips-plays-without, music-presets-that-build-a-library-of-scored-tra, screen-recordings-sit-on-a-designed-backdrop-no, transitions-that-feel-expensive-a-modern-set-wit; the title losing a line went onto a-main-title-headline-keeps-its-second-line-afte. Build on that list rather than rediscovering it; this task's reference board and gap ranking still stand.
